# Format fixtures

All files in this folder were written for Motionary's tests and are MIT-licensed with the repository: `sample-keyframes.css`, `sample-motion.json` (10.1), `sample-smil.svg` (10.2), `texturepacker-hash.json`, `texturepacker-array.json`, `aseprite.json` (10.3, hand-written in the TexturePacker / Aseprite export formats; no third-party art). Third-party samples added later are listed here with their licence and source.

## 10.4 animated images (made for Motionary, MIT)

- `sample-anim.gif`, `sample-anim.png` (APNG), `sample-anim.webp` (lossless), `sample-anim-lossy.webp` — four coloured rectangles drawn with Pillow (`ImageDraw`), saved with Pillow 12 (`save_all=True`, per-frame durations, GIF disposal 2 + transparency, APNG sub-frames, WebP ANMF frames).
- `sample-interlaced.gif` — the same frames re-encoded by ImageMagick 6 (`convert sample-anim.gif -coalesce -interlace GIF -loop 3`).
- `sample-plasma.gif` — 96×64 ImageMagick `plasma:fractal` + `gradient:red-blue`, 256 colours (exercises 12-bit LZW codes).
- `sample-alpha-lossy.webp` — three semi-transparent shapes (ImageMagick `-draw`), lossy WebP with `ALPH` chunks via ImageMagick's libwebp encoder.
- `animated-images.expected.json` — reference results computed with Pillow from the same files (SHA-256 of each composited frame; decoded sub-frames for the decoder stub used in Node, which has no PNG / WebP decoder).

## 10.5 3D models and video

- `sample-scene.glb`, `sample-scene.gltf` (made for Motionary, MIT) — generated by a small Python script in the release tooling: textured quad (interleaved buffer, byteStride 32, embedded PNG), child node with a TRIANGLE_STRIP using uint8 indices and normalised UNSIGNED_BYTE texcoords, a matrix node, two scenes; the `.gltf` carries the same buffer as a `data:` URI.
- `sample-cube.obj`, `sample-cube.mtl`, `sample-checker.png` (made for Motionary, MIT) — hand-written cube with two materials, quads, negative indices and a second object; 8×8 checker texture drawn with Pillow.
- `sample-clip.webm` (VP9), `sample-clip.mp4` (H.264) (made for Motionary, MIT) — 2 s of FFmpeg's `testsrc` pattern, 160×90.
- `khronos-box.glb` — "Box" from the Khronos glTF-Sample-Assets repository (https://github.com/KhronosGroup/glTF-Sample-Assets/tree/main/Models/Box), © 2017 Cesium, licensed **CC-BY 4.0** (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Unmodified.

## 10.6 vector animation

- `sample-vector.json`, `sample-vector.lottie` (made for Motionary, MIT) — generated by a small Python script in the release tooling: a 100×100, 30 fps, 60-frame Lottie that exercises one supported feature per region (position keyframes, trim paths, an alpha track matte, a precomp, masks, gradients, an embedded image); the `.lottie` is the same animation zipped with a dotLottie manifest (stored + deflate entries).
- `rive-message-icon.riv` — `message_icon.riv` from the official Rive web runtime repository (https://github.com/rive-app/rive-wasm/blob/master/wasm/examples/parcel_example/message_icon.riv), © Rive, **MIT License** (https://github.com/rive-app/rive-wasm/blob/master/LICENSE). Unmodified. Used only to check `<usa-rive>` with the official runtime; Motionary does not parse `.riv`.
